title: Zymobiomics Magbead Nucleic Acid Purification - v2
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect a NEST deep‑well plate (96‑well, 2 mL) or equivalent, Opentrons P300 single‑channel electronic pipette, Opentrons P300 8‑channel (multi‑channel) electronic pipette, and 300 µL tip racks.

steps.title: Load original samples
steps.instruction: Place a 4 × 6 (24‑well) 2 mL screw‑cap tube aluminum block in slot 2 and load original samples into tubes A1‑D6 (up to 24 samples, filled down columns then across rows).

steps.title: Replace tubes with water (mid‑protocol)
steps.instruction: When prompted mid‑run, replace tubes A1‑C1 in the same block with molecular‑grade water tubes (one water tube for each set of 8 samples).

steps.title: Fill reagent reservoir
steps.instruction: Place a 12‑channel reagent reservoir in slot 4 and fill the channels as follows:

steps.title: Set up waste reservoir
steps.instruction: Place a waste reservoir in slot 11. The protocol is programmed for an Agilent 290 mL single‑channel reservoir, but any reservoir can be used if calibrated to the top of the reservoir before the run.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the mount sides for the P300 single‑channel and multi‑channel pipettes, the total number of samples, the bead volume (µL), the bead separation time (minutes), and indicate whether a temperature module will be used for drying.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the custom Zymobiomics Magbead nucleic‑acid purification protocol (API v2) to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 app.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the deep‑well plate, aluminum block, reagent reservoir, waste reservoir, and any modules in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 app, calibrate the positions of the deep‑well plate, aluminum block, reagent reservoir, waste reservoir, and tip racks, as well as the P300 single‑channel and multi‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 app to start the automated Zymobiomics Magbead nucleic‑acid purification.
